summary: Shen Feizhi deals with a security guard at the Shen family villa and discovers bloodstains in the garden, confirming a confrontation between Gu Suizhou and Lin Sui. He encounters Shen Wei, who is furious about Gu Suizhou (using the alias Lin Zhou), but is interrupted by Elder Shen. Elder Shen attempts to manipulate Shen Feizhi into a political marriage, hinting at past grudges between the Shen and Lin families. Meanwhile, Gu Suizhou is cornered by a group of gossiping Omegas and their partners; in a fit of annoyance, he boasts about Shen Feizhi's prowess, leading to an unwanted drinking challenge for Shen Feizhi upon his arrival.
